title: Image Compressor
description: A browser-based image compressor: drag in photos or screenshots, tune quality/format/size, and download the result — all client-side, nothing ever gets uploaded.

title: Color Palette Generator
description: Generate an accessible tonal palette from a base color or an uploaded image's dominant colors, with live WCAG contrast-ratio checks for every shade.

title: EXIF Viewer & Editor
description: View every EXIF/metadata field hiding in your JPEG and PNG photos — camera, exposure, timestamps, GPS location — then edit, delete, or add fields, or strip it all out losslessly, straight from the raw file bytes, with nothing ever uploaded.
